title: More ways to make things
summary:
Eight community directory additions, from collaborative comics to developer tools and projects in Japanese and Portuguese.

The Creative Projects directory added two image generators, Mixbash’s bring-your-own-key model interface, and StoryWeaver AI, which uses Pollinations text and image APIs to build shared comic-style stories. The listings also now distinguish the official Pollinations MCP server from a community-maintained project.

Hack-and-Build added an OpenAI-compatible proxy for Pollinations text, image, and speech services, plus unpkg.ai, which generates JavaScript ESM modules on demand.

The directory added a Japanese-language chat project and EduGen AI, a Brazilian Portuguese tool that creates slide images for teachers. Both listings include language tags and translated descriptions.
